content.comment_body: Hello everyone! I'm currently working on a project requiring the use of a [product_name] ([article_no]), along with an expansion module ([article_no]). I'm unable to find details explaining how to connect these two modules physically, or instructions on how to address the I/O from the expanded module within the [product_name] software. Any help would be greatly appreciated. [user_name]

The expansion modules are attached to the right side of the main module. Begin by removing the protective cover for the contact slide on the main module, and then move the contact slide to the left until it locks in place.
